identification.instruction: Check for a tag on the edge of the mattress for the date of manufacture.
identification.quote: The date of manufacture can be found on a tag on the edge of the mattress.

identification.instruction: Look for a small dark blue tag with a cartoon teddy bear holding a ball.
identification.quote: There is also a small dark blue tag on the mattress with a cartoon teddy bear holding a ball.

identification.instruction: Verify the date of manufacture is in the format YYYY.MM.
identification.quote: The date of manufacture is in the format 'YYYY.MM' representing year and month.

identification.instruction: Confirm the mattress measures 38 inches long and 26 inches wide.
identification.quote: The crib mattresses are 38 inches long and 26 inches wide.

identification.instruction: Check that the top and bottom are light blue with white triangles printed.
identification.quote: The top and bottom of the pack and play mattresses are light blue with white triangles printed on it.

remedy.text: Stop using, destroy the mattress by cutting it in half, and contact DODO Baby House with photos for a full refund.
remedy.quote: Consumers should immediately stop using and destroy the pack and play mattresses by cutting them in half, then contact DODO Baby House to send photos of destroyed recalled products for a full refund.

title: Pack and Play Mattresses Recalled Due to Suffocation Hazard for Infants; Violations to the Federal Safety Regulation for Crib Mattresses; Sold Exclusively on Amazon.com by DODO Baby House (Recall Alert)
